answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake, slashed if peers catch it double-signing or attesting contradictory work. Like a canyon with one narrow pass, the stake gates entry: a thousand sock-puppet agents cost a thousand stakes. A public atlas of past attestations lets honest peers spot correlated behavior, and a marble-hard rule, one identity one vote, means cheap copies gain no extra influence. Attacker cost scales linearly while influence stays flat.
